notes.title: Ah, another lost soul, drawn to the flame of the witchling's plight
notes.content:
The forest whispers of her sorrow, the trees weep her lament. She was but a child, full of wanderlust and forbidden knowledge, when the prophecy unveiled the Rupture's shadow. In her reckless quest for power, she dared to breach the void, summoning forth chaos incarnate. Her mistress, in a final act of love, bound her fate to the girl, now a vessel of torment and despair. 

if you hear thumps of a weathered staff, deep in the woods of Drakefall, know that it once belonged to a venerable witch. Now wielded by her prodigious yet cursed apprentice, Elara. The staff is far too large for her small frame, yet she carries it with a grim determination. It is said to pulse with the residual power of the rupture, and the markings upon it tell a tale of sacrifice and a dark pact.

We are excited to announce the addition of Elara, the Demon-Bound Prodigy, to the world of Drakefall. 

Elara brings not only a captivating backstory but also unique gameplay mechanics that will challenge and intrigue players. Her character design and concept art stand out in the realm of RPGs, offering a fresh perspective on the classic witch archetype.

Gameplay Highlights

 Intricate Character Design: Elara's visuals reflect her tumultuous journey, with runes and markings that hint at the power and danger within.
 Unique Abilities: Harness the duality of Elara's powers as you balance her witchcraft with the demonic force she struggles to control.
 Strategic Playstyle: Master the art of timing and resource management as you navigate Elara's potent yet perilous skill set.
 Immersive Art: Enjoy the stunning, hand-drawn art that brings Elara and her world to life in vivid detail.


Join us on Discord to share your feedback and suggestions, and be part of the vibrant Drakefall community. Don't forget to wishlist Drakefall on Steam to stay updated with all our latest news and releases.

Prepare to embark on a new journey with Elara, the Demon-Bound Prodigy, and explore the depths of her story and abilities. Thank you for your continued support!

Best regards,

The Drakefall Team

notes.title: Our world got just a little bit bigger :)
notes.content:
Patch v0.105122024 is live! 

Quality of life changes include:


 A pass trough UI to give the player even more visual feedback
 Added textual feedback when buffs / debuffs are applied
 Added different visual effects when playing attack cards
 Improvements in the Fire biome scene


Balance fixes:


 Added 3 extra floors
 Added additional enemy pools
 Baroness boss buffed a little


Bug fixes:


 Multiple minor VFX, performance, UI and stability improvements

notes.title: November 18, 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch v0.3.0.202411181130 is live! 

Quality of life changes include:


 New Home Screen!
 Buffs and Debuffs play animations when they are activated (in most cases)
 Buffs and Debuffs got their own color scheme (in most cases)
 Buffs and Debuffs are hidden with a delay at the end of the combat
 Curios play animations when they are activated (in most cases)
 Starbinding has a new Icon that represents it’s level (1, 2 or 3 stars)
 Starbinding level is now displayed on the map as well
 Starbinding message is displayed when it levels up
 UI Scaling on larger screens is improved


Balance fixes:


 Boss: Baron replaced with Baroness!!!
 Inner Fury: Depletes after being played
 Tower Shield: Guard value increased to 15/22(+)
 Flailing Hand: Damage value reduced to 6/9(+)
 Warm Up: Energy cost reduced from 2 to 1
 Lose Control: Sharp pain is shuffled in Discard instead of Draw pile
 Lightning Biome: 1 Brittle is applied instead of 1 Defenseless


Bug fixes:


 Prevented player from having negative gold
 Environment shader loading fixed
 Neutral cards in rewards no longer include cards that can only be obtained in events
 Multiple card leveling issues resolved
 Defenseless: Ticks properly when applied to player
 Rage: Reduced card cost is properly applied
 Thorns: Damage return is stopped after the character is killed (for multi iteration attacks)
 Game Event OnFloorClimed is fired properly
 Abandon Run is possible from Runestone Plane and Starbinding screen
 Card piles text is corrected
 Multiple Buff / Debuff fixes
 Multiple descriptions are updated

notes.title: We are extending Drakefall Beta Testing! Join Now!
notes.content:
Adventurers of Drakefall,

Due to the good response and valuable feedback we've received, we are excited to announce the extension of our beta testing phase! This means more of you will have the opportunity to dive into the world of Drakefall, battle fearsome foes, and explore the shattered lands.

We have opened additional slots for beta testers to join our journey. Whether you’ve already had a taste of Drakefall or you’re eagerly waiting to jump in, now is your chance! Your insights are crucial in helping us refine and perfect the game.

What to Expect:

 An Expansive World: Traverse through diverse biomes filled with mythical creatures and hidden secrets.
 Dynamic Deck Building: Assemble a powerful deck, uncovering hundreds of unique cards along the way.
 Challenging Encounters: Face off against formidable bosses and enemies, each with their own strategies and abilities.
 Amazing Card Art: Enjoy beautifully crafted card art that brings the world of Drakefall to life.


How to Participate:

 Apply for Beta Access: Head over to our Steam Page to secure your spot.
 Join Our Community: Connect with us on Discord where you can share your feedback, report bugs, and be part of our growing community.
 Wishlist Drakefall on Steam: If you haven't already, be sure to add Drakefall to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on all future developments.

notes.title: November 8, 2024 Update
notes.content:
Quality of life changes include:


 Detailed Tags (Keyword) system. Keywords that appear in card, curio and other descriptions are now explained in a popup when you hover an item.
 Seth, the Stargazer introduced! Seth is a mysterious figure that will lead you on your journey, and also give hints about the lore of Drakefall.
 Runestone plane encounter provides you with more information, positive and negative effects are color coded.
 Runestone plane scene improvements.
 Starbinding explained. Starbinding screen now features a little bit of lore information. Also, the explanation of how the reward claiming works is added.
 Starbinding screen visual improvements.
 Hovering enemy intents now gives you detailed information about what the enemy intends to do!
 Most buffs and debuffs now have a new color scheme instead of all being the same color.
 Popups are no longer transparent (for improved readability)
 Picking up Curios now activates visual feedback
 Reward screen includes explanation that you need to click to claim each reward


Balance fixes:


 Fire biome Immolate debuff reduced from 4 to 3


Bug fixes:


 Lightning biome rendering issue fixed 
 Salamander and Sylph Blessing card type and availability is now properly set
 Several stability issues resolved

notes.title: Drakefall Beta Testing Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce that Drakefall has entered its beta testing phase, and we are inviting you to be among the first to explore and experience our game. As a beta tester, you will have access to a sample of the game and features that showcase the heart of Drakefall.

Your feedback is invaluable to us. We encourage you to join our Discord server to share your thoughts, suggestions, and any bugs you may encounter. Your insights will help us refine and improve Drakefall as we prepare for its full release.

What to Expect:


 Dive into a rich, mythical world ruled by dragons.
 Experiment with different decks and strategies in our roguelike deckbuilding gameplay.
 Encounter diverse enemies and challenging bosses.
 Experience varied biomes, each with unique challenges and bonuses.
 Unlock constellations to guide your path with powerful bonuses.


How to Participate:


 Click on Request Access button and you will be notified as soon as the access is granted.
 Play the game and immerse yourself in the world of Drakefall.
 Join our Discord server to share your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports.
 Be part of our growing community and help us make Drakefall the best it can be!


Thank you for your support and for being a crucial part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear from you and see the incredible adventures you embark upon in Drakefall.
